The twelve Units of Klasse 7 (E) across the school
year. Each Unit covers roughly three teaching weeks.

| Unit | Title | Skills focus | Exam type |
|------|-------|--------------|-----------|
| 1 | [First Day Back](units/unit01_first-day-back.qmd) | speaking, listening, writing, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 2 | [Growing Up](units/unit02_growing-up.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 3 | [Media in Our Lives](units/unit03_media-in-our-lives.qmd) | listening, writing, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 4 | [A Trip to Scotland](units/unit04_a-trip-to-scotland.qmd) | reading, listening, intercultural | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 5 | [The United States Today](units/unit05_the-united-states-today.qmd) | reading, writing, intercultural | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 6 | [Food Cultures](units/unit06_food-cultures.qmd) | reading, speaking, intercultural | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 7 | [Being a Friend](units/unit07_being-a-friend.qmd) | speaking, writing, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 8 | [Erste Mediation: A German E-mail](units/unit08_first-mediation.qmd) | mediation, writing, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 9 | [School Rules and Rights](units/unit09_school-rules-and-rights.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 10 | [Reading a Short Story](units/unit10_a-short-story.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 11 | [Plans for the Summer](units/unit11_plans-for-the-summer.qmd) | speaking, writing, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 12 | [Year Review: A Class Podcast](units/unit12_year-review-and-podcast.qmd) | speaking, listening, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
